note: Campgrounds along the north and west shores of Webster Reservoir west of Stockton: Eagle Landing (long pull-throughs on a peninsula), Old Marina and Hill Top in the west cluster, plus Lake View, Rock Point and Goose Flat (electric only, by the dam) farther east; two modern cabins, swim beaches, and 100+ non-reservable primitive sites besides the ones on campitks (ReserveAmerica park brochure). Reservable online Apr 1-Sep 30; FCFS Oct-Mar (KDWP). Irrigation reservoir often sits well below conservation pool, so the walk to the water is long at low levels. --Claude
summary: campitks per-site read: 93 utility sites in six loops (1 FHU, 86 W/E mostly 50 A, 6 electric-only) + 13 reservable primitive; open year round, showers, holiday 3-night min, 14-night cap. flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakeview' stands, judged per loop. Eagle Landing (peninsula, sites ~50-150 m from the high-water edge with the park road along the west side) and Hill Top (elevated, ~150+ m back) - lakeview; campitks 'River/Lake View: Y' on all 36. Old Marina - mostly no view (view 'Y' on 6 of 31; 043-051 nearest the west shore). Lake View loop 068-077 - a row of back-ins ~30-60 m above the high-water sand line with open, bare ground between; Goose Flat 088-093 - top of the open sand bank west of the dam, ~10-40 m to the sand's upper edge. Both could be lakefront under the open-apron rule, but the frames can't tell a walkable bank from a scarp and the reservoir was far below pool; unsure, so lakeview. Rock Point 078-087 - hilltop loop ~120-200 m back, lakeview.

SPLIT CANDIDATES (separate places ~1 km+ apart, each on its own park road): (1) LAKE VIEW loop - 10 water/electric 50/30/20 A, 32-52 ft back-ins (068 32 ft), no pull-throughs, showers within 1/4 mile, all prime; centroid 39.40889,-99.44215, ~1.2 km ENE of Hill Top; reached by the park road running east from the west cluster (cabins Pintail Place / Bluewing Bungalow beside it); waterfront lakeview (above). (2) ROCK POINT - 10 water/electric 50/30/20 A (40-125 ft, back-in; 1 pull-through) + 8 primitive (shelters 808-813 strung along the shore road), showers within 1/4 mile for 13 sites and within 1 mile for 6; utility-loop centroid ~39.4166,-99.4332, ~1.3 km NE of Lake View, entered from the north-side road; lakeview. (3) GOOSE FLAT - 6 electric-only 30/20 A back-ins, 40-54 ft, NO showers ('Outside Facility'), vault toilet within 1/4 mile; centroid 39.39816,-99.42466, ~2.5 km E of the west cluster beside the dam's west end, reached by its own road from the south-east; lakeview (possible lakefront). The west cluster (Eagle Landing 20, Old Marina 31, Hill Top 16 within ~550 m, centroid ~39.4006,-99.4538) stays as 2087.
PIN 39.3993,-99.4534 is on Old Marina / Eagle Landing (Old Marina centroid 39.40031,-99.45438, ~110 m); OK for the west cluster.
